title: Point of Sale
subtitle: Scan a barcode or type the medicine name — the search fixes typos and suggests similar products.
addProductDesc: The dropdown suggests products as you type, and Enter after a scan adds the product directly — scanner errors are corrected automatically.
resumeConfirm: The current invoice has items — it will be replaced by the parked invoice. Continue?
startEmpty: Start by scanning or searching by name
discountInvalidPercent: Enter a valid value between 0 and 100
discountInvalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in EGP
discountPercentError: Enter a discount percentage between 0 and 100
discountAmountError: Enter a valid discount amount in EGP
customerAutoAddedHint: The customer will be added to customer accounts automatically and the invoice will be recorded as credit.
customerSearchPlaceholder: Search for a customer by name or phone…
customerNoResults: No matching results — you can add a new customer.
totalsHint: Totals here are instant estimates for display; the backend re-verifies prices and stock on approval.
creditSaleSuccess: Credit invoice recorded for “{name}” for {total} — follow it up from the customer accounts page.
printPrepareFailed: Invoice saved but printing could not be prepared — press “Print invoice” to retry
customerNameRequired: Enter the new customer's name first
creditRequiresCustomer: Credit sale requires selecting a customer from the list or adding a new one
defaultThankYou: Thank you for your trust — your health is our mission
defaultReturnPolicy: Returns within 14 days with the original receipt
searchAria: Search by name or scan a barcode
searchPlaceholder: Scan a barcode or type the medicine name…
noResults: No matching results — try another part of the name or the active ingredient
barcodeNotExact: Barcode is not an exact match — pick the right product from the list
barcodeNoProduct: No product with this barcode — try searching by name
